_comment: Written by ./install.sh (interactive). Or copy to config.json and edit. Gitignored — per-user.
_harnesses: Targets: link the unified store into these harnesses.
_adopt_from: Sources: pull existing skills/memory/instructions/commands FROM these into the store (subset of targets).
_accounts: ILLUSTRATIVE SHAPE ONLY — `make install` auto-detects YOUR real Claude accounts (from your ~/.claude* dirs) and asks about ChatGPT/keys; it does not use the entries below. Provider-agnostic, add any number of any type. provider = anthropic-sub (config_dir = a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR + optional keychain) | chatgpt-sub (token_dir = its own CHATGPT_TOKEN_DIR/CODEX_HOME so multiple logins don't collide + port for its LiteLLM instance) | openai-key (env_key + base_url).
_claude_in_opencode: OPT-IN, BAN RISK. Reuse a Claude subscription inside opencode via opencode-claude-auth. Anthropic restricts subscription tokens to official clients (bans since Jan 2026). false = Claude stays in Claude Code only (recommended for team use).
